items.t: Settings: a What's new button lists what has changed since the last version, in a short pop-up. The Settings button shows a dot until you've read it.

Settings: opens as a drawer over the page instead of a page of its own, with four tabs (This device, Character, Table, About). Close it with ×, Escape or a click outside, and you're right where you were.

Skills & Talents: click a folded perk to deal out just its cards (both levels, for a perk like Wreck 3–4), and click it again to fold them back. The skill's own button still opens or folds every perk at once.
Settings: Animations can be switched off for this browser. Themes keep their artwork but hold still, which is easier on older phones.
